provenance.boundary_source: NJOGIS NJ Counties 3857 hosted feature layer
provenance.boundary_copy: County-only geometry extracted from the user’s NJ_Name_Atlas.html Library artifact. No name-history research data is reused.
provenance.boundary_precision: Previously generalized for display; original simplification tolerance not recorded in that artifact. Not a boundary survey.
provenance.join_method: Line/polygon intersections after transforming the stored longitude/latitude polygons into EPSG:3424. Keep whole interchanges. Additional county membership requires at least max(15 feet, 0.5% of a selected branch length) of overlap. Minor overlaps remain in audit. Primary county has the most total selected-path length.
provenance.border_note: Generalized county boundaries are suitable for browsing. Near-boundary affiliations are approximate; groups associated with more than one county are available in both and deduplicated in the full collection.
provenance.land_context: NJ-only coastline from the prior atlas’s Census 2017 / us-atlas 3.0.1 display mask; not used in county association.
